Hi Hannah / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team was impressed with routing/fallback and the dedicated capacity options. We need to accelerate the security handoff so we can get SSO + SCIM, IP allowlist, and service account provisioning lined up before our pilot begins August 4.

Quick asks to unblock our security review:
- Official SAML metadata endpoint for Redwood (entityID/ACS) and confirmation of signed assertions.
- SCIM attribute map (user email, displayName, department, manager) and whether group sync is supported.
- Typical service account naming conventions and required scopes for SCIM provisioning.
- IP ranges for the production endpoint so our network team can open the firewall.

I've attached a checklist (pinegrove-sso-scim-checklist.xlsx) and a preliminary allowlist file from our infra team. Can you confirm contact for the DocuSign/PO and any runbook we should sign off on?

Elaine

Hannah / team — jumping in with a proposed implementation plan and timing (high level):

Week 1 (2025-07-09 to 2025-07-15):
- Exchange SAML metadata and verify assertion signatures.
- Validate SCIM attribute mapping against a sample CSV of 10 pilot users.
- Network allowlist synced with PineGrove IT; ensure NAT and peering IPs are open.

Week 2 (2025-07-16 to 2025-07-22):
- Configure SCIM provisioning to staging; provision pilot group.
- Create service accounts in Redwood for provisioning and audit logs; test minimal scopes.
- DPO to review retention policy and user data mapping (Monica to provide sample data flows).

Cutover window (target 2025-07-28 01:00-03:00 PDT):
- 2-hour low-traffic window; perform final sync, enable SSO for pilot org unit, monitor logs.
- Canary rollback plan: immediate disable SSO and fall back to email invite if critical auth errors observed.

Dependencies / open items:
- Signed MOP / PO (Ben)
- DocuSign envelope (Ben)
- DPO confirmation on SCIM attributes retained for audit (Elaine / DPO)
- Confirm admin contact and test user list (Elaine)

I'll attach a compact runbook and post-cutover checklist after the technical sync.

Thanks — Monica
